findings.suggested_fix: Translate the sense "I bless Thee" as a doxological/praise statement. For example: "Aku memberkati-Mu;" or "Aku memuji-Mu;" Preserve punctuation and HTML tags.

findings.location: <div class="poem"> stanza 2, line 2 ("I greet Thy going forth;")

findings.location: <div class="poem"> stanza 5, line 2 ("Divine Redeemer, graciously / Renew this heart of mine.")

Divine Redeemer, graciously

Penebus Ilahi, dengan murah hati
Perbaharuilah hati ini milikku.
